scope.meaning: Classifications cover stated source contracts and work, including dormant guarantees. Matched means only the stated immediate policy; no row-wide parity or cost attribution follows.

identity.byteDomain: Repository source hashes use UTF-8 file bytes with CRLF normalized to LF for checkout portability. MessagePipe source hashes use exact installed package bytes.

comparisonBases.extra: Extra or different guarantee/bookkeeping on the named side; no performance advantage is inferred.
comparisonBases.matched: Only synchronous immediate callback propagation/abort policy is matched; different unwind bookkeeping is recorded separately.

dxmessaging.description: Lower priorities first; equal-priority registrations retain logical insertion order across handler owners. Four priority buckets are used only in PriorityOrdered.

messagepipe.description: Publish walks captured physical array slots; FreeList reuses FIFO free indices, so hole reuse can reorder new subscribers before older survivors. Filter Order orders middleware within one subscriber, not subscribers.

dxmessaging.description: Each invoked entry checks MessageHandler.active live. Enabled tokens own registrations; token Disable deregisters but does not make a frozen entry inactive. Public owners are active.

messagepipe.description: Each captured array entry is null-checked. Subscription disposal removes a slot; no reusable MessageHandler.active equivalent exists on this synchronous path.

dxmessaging.description: Normal callback additions wait for the next or nested snapshot; removing a pending callback leaves it in the outer frozen snapshot unless owner activity changes. Interceptor mutation precedes normal snapshot acquisition.

messagepipe.description: Publish retains one backing array reference. Spare-slot add/remove can affect the outer loop; growth changes the current array and leaves the outer one unchanged. Removing the last keyed subscription removes its holder; replacement uses a new holder.

dxmessaging.description: Post snapshots freeze before interceptors/handlers; normal handler snapshots are acquired after interceptors. Immutable phase arrays and dispatch leases preserve in-flight views; route rewrites require route-specific evidence.

messagepipe.description: Keyless Publish reads GetValues once. Keyed Publish captures the holder array while holding the key lookup lock, then invokes outside it. Neither clones the array; filter chains are assembled at subscription time.

dxmessaging.description: ResetState advances a generation, clears registrations/sinks, aborts remaining callbacks after a generation change, and defers release of active snapshots. Reset is reusable runtime behavior, not invoked by public rows.

messagepipe.description: No reusable reset counterpart in this synchronous broker. Core Dispose is terminal; default subsequent Subscribe is ignored. Already captured publish arrays can still invoke pending callbacks after core disposal.

dxmessaging.description: Synchronous nested emission is allowed; scoped emission IDs and dispatch leases preserve outer state and displaced snapshots. Nested normal-handler mutation sees a new snapshot while the outer snapshot remains frozen.

messagepipe.description: Nested Publish captures then-current storage. Outer Publish retains its prior array, which can remain live-mutated when capacity did not grow. No DxMessaging scoped ID/lease mechanism is present.

dxmessaging.description: Synchronous callback exceptions propagate and abort remaining callbacks. Normal-handler throw skips the later post phase. DispatchLease performs unwind bookkeeping; callback success precedes token diagnostic recording.

messagepipe.description: Synchronous callback exceptions propagate and abort remaining array iteration. After-next middleware has no finally, so a terminal handler throw skips its post body.

dxmessaging.description: Bridge sets bus DiagnosticsMode=false and token DiagnosticMode=false. The token diagnostic branch remains; MessagingDebug is an independent setting and is not set by this bridge.

messagepipe.description: Default EnableCaptureStackTrace=false suppresses stack capture, but diagnostics subscription counters still use Interlocked increment/decrement and dirty-state updates. This lifecycle work is timed in SubUnsub.

dxmessaging.description: One active owner/token per listener, reusable registration handles, Enable/Disable and UnregisterAll. Churn reuses an enabled token and cached readonly-ref delegate. Final bridge cleanup unregisters and disposes tokens.

messagepipe.description: Subscribe(Action) creates an AnonymousMessageHandler wrapper and Subscription tied to a free-list slot. Dispose removes the slot and updates diagnostics. Cached Action avoids delegate creation only. Builtin provider implements IServiceProvider, not IDisposable; bridge disposes subscriptions then drops references.

dxmessaging.description: Typed/context slots, dispatch snapshots, token storage and bounded shared pools have distinct lifetimes. Typed emission checks idle sweep policy; Trim and deferred release reclaim different holders. Registration count alone does not prove storage or GC reclamation.

messagepipe.description: Live FreeList storage does not shrink. Keyless last removal shrinks capacity greater than 8 to 4; empty capacity 8 stays 8. Last keyed subscription removes its dictionary holder. Core Dispose instead retains empty keyed holders. Neither observation proves dictionary backing-array shrink or object collection.

dxmessaging.description: The bus contract is single-threaded; benchmark callbacks execute synchronously on the caller thread. No concurrent mutation guarantee is inferred.

messagepipe.description: Registration/disposal are locked; keyed lookup is locked before callbacks; keyless Publish has no lock. Diagnostics uses Interlocked and array growth uses Volatile.Write. These operations do not establish safety for every racing Dispose sequence.

dxmessaging.description: Public Broadcast returns void. Internal foundAnyHandlers includes registered-bucket semantics and gates optional MessagingDebug reporting; it is not simply the number of callbacks.

messagepipe.description: Public Publish returns void; absent key returns and empty/null slots do no callback work. No equivalent caller-visible found bool or DxMessaging found bookkeeping exists.

topologyDefaults.diagnostics: DX bus/token false; MessagingDebug is separate and not set here. MP default stack capture false; subscription counters remain active.

allocationWork.status: unmeasured in this ledger; never substitute zero
allocationWork.scope: GC.Alloc uses the separate existing untimed probe. Non-development IL2CPP Release strips the profiler; its result remains Unmeasured. Source new sites do not predict backend counts.
allocationWork.dxmessaging: Churn stages/registers/removes via a reused token and cached delegate; dispatch may refresh snapshots and run reclamation bookkeeping. No allocation count is inferred.
allocationWork.messagepipe: Action wrapper and Subscription allocate on Subscribe; filter chain setup outside timed dispatch. Churn includes Subscribe/Dispose allocations and diagnostics. Unsupported PriorityOrdered has no MP work.

cleanup.timing: Final cleanup outside dispatch timing; SubUnsub per-cycle pair is inside operation.
cleanup.dxmessaging: UnregisterAll then Dispose each token in reverse order; drops references. Six live registration counters are tested; retained pool/slot capacity and collection are separate.
cleanup.messagepipe: Dispose stored subscriptions in reverse order, then drop broker/provider references. Last keyed subscription removes holder; core Dispose is a distinct characterization that retains empty holder.

contractTests.scope: Topology twin tests compare actual public DX bridge with independent DX workload. No native result is bound by this draft; this is not MP topology or semantic equality evidence.

dxmessaging.physicalStatus: unresolved: slots, snapshots, token arenas and pools require separate observations

GlobalToOne.workloadScope: One fresh keyless listener; no mutation, nesting, throw, reset, or activity toggle is performed by the measured callback.

storage.description: Fresh contiguous backing array: 1 live / 4 physical. Not a direct public bridge runtime capture.

GlobalToMany.workloadScope: Sixteen fresh keyless listeners, contiguous initial registration order; no holes or callback-time mutation in the measured row.

storage.description: Fresh contiguous backing array: 16 live / 16 physical. Not a direct public bridge runtime capture.

KeyedToOne.workloadScope: Sixteen distinct routes, one matching listener invoked: DX InstanceId 41000 among 41000..41015; MP key 0 among 0..15. Keyed lookup work is timed.

storage.description: Per keyed holder 1 live / 4 physical, aggregate 16 / 64; dictionary capacity unobserved.

PriorityOrdered.workloadScope: DX invokes priorities 0,1,2,3 on one owner/token. MessagePipeBridge.Supports returns false; no MP operation or comparison ratio exists for this row.

Filtered.workloadScope: DX uses one bus-wide allowing interceptor and one normal handler; MP uses one subscriber-local allowing predicate. Rejection and filter mutation are not exercised.

storage.description: Fresh contiguous backing array: 1 live / 4 physical. Not a direct public bridge runtime capture.

PostProcess.workloadScope: DX uses one separate post registration plus one normal handler; MP uses after-next middleware on one subscriber. The empty post body does not increment the progress marker.

storage.description: Fresh contiguous backing array: 1 live / 4 physical. Not a direct public bridge runtime capture.

FilteredPostProcess.workloadScope: DX uses interceptor, normal and separate post registrations; MP uses a subscriber-local predicate outside after-next middleware. Both predicates allow and post bodies are empty.

storage.description: Fresh contiguous backing array: 1 live / 4 physical. Not a direct public bridge runtime capture.

SubUnsub.workloadScope: No payload is published and no callback is invoked. Each operation registers/removes once and increments a synthetic lifecycle progress marker; transient registration must be observed separately.

storage.description: Empty before/after cycle, transient 1 live / 4 physical; free slots rotate.

StructNoBox.workloadScope: Both dispatch the exact ComparisonStructPayload(1) type. DX passes by readonly reference and MP by value; exact payload identity does not imply any other semantic match.
